Initial release of "smyx-child-dangerous-object-detection-analysis":

- Introduces real-time AI detection of children interacting with dangerous objects or electrical sockets based on fixed camera video feeds in home and childcare environments.
- Provides immediate alerts and warning notifications via mobile app or smart speaker when dangerous behaviors are detected.
- Features strict open-id (user identification) acquisition and API invocation rules to ensure accurate report access and privacy compliance.
- Supports detection of preset dangerous items (e.g., scissors, knives, medicine bottles, lighters, cleaning agents, electrical sockets) and categorizes risk actions (e.g., grab, hold near mouth, insert into socket).
- Allows structured historical report querying and formatted output with on-site images for parent/guardian review.
- Can be integrated as a safety feature in smart cameras for homes with children and in educational settings.
